On Fri, Jan 10, 2026 at 11:07 AM rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai wrote:
> Thanks June — received. We can meet your timeline. Initial notes below and attached first-pass responses.

June / Rishi / Procurement team — I'm Marissa from Security & Compliance. I reviewed the questionnaire and attached a redline of the BAA and an internal note summarizing controls you requested. Key points (executive summary):

- Data classification & PHI: Redwood treats PHI as customer data; for hosted customers we offer contractual controls and encryption at-rest/in-transit. For customers requiring PHI processing we recommend Dedicated or Private deployment with customer-managed KMS.
- Access controls: Role-based access, strict least-privilege ACLs, audit logging of token-level requests, and dedicated audit streams for customers under Dedicated/Private. We provide token-level tracing in Redwood Console for incident review.
- Encryption & keys: We support customer-managed keys (KMS/HSM) for Private/Dedicated and default envelope encryption for hosted. Keys are rotated per industry best practices; details in attached note.
- Incident response & breach notification: We maintain an IR playbook with 72-hour notification SLA for confirmed breaches involving PHI; for incidents impacting PHI we will engage the customer's security contacts per the BAA.
- Data retention & deletion: We provide configurable retention in Private/Dedicated; hosted customers can request data purge via API and we support contractual retention guarantees in Enterprise agreements.

Attached: BAA_draft_Redwood_v1.docx (with redlines); HIPAA_questionnaire_Redwood_Response_v1.xlsx (annotated); Security_Control_Summary_for_StMarys_2026-01-13.pdf

Open items for St. Mary's legal/security to confirm:
1) Does St. Mary's require Redwood to sign an amended BAA with specific indemnity changes? If so, please highlight the clauses you need revised.
2) For hosted API use, is de-identified data an acceptable pathway or do you require all PHI to be processed only in Dedicated/Private?
3) Preferred contact and timeline for SOC2 report review and any onsite audit request.

Rishi — I flagged two BAA clauses for discussion (liability cap and subcontractor flow-down). I recommend the call include your legal lead and a member of our product security team (David cc'd) to discuss deployment options.
